dish.title: Slow-Cooker Cuban Ropa Vieja with White Rice
dish.description: Beef chuck slow-cooked all day with peppers, onion, garlic, tomato, cumin, and oregano until it pulls into tender shreds, then finished with green olives and a splash of vinegar. Served over white rice with cilantro.

recipe_version.title: Slow-Cooker Cuban Ropa Vieja with White Rice
recipe_version.description: Beef chuck slow-cooked all day with peppers, onion, garlic, tomato, cumin, and oregano until it pulls into tender shreds, then finished with green olives and a splash of vinegar. Served over white rice with cilantro.

steps.title: Load the slow cooker
steps.body: Slice the onion and both bell peppers and mince the garlic. Put half the vegetables in the slow cooker. Season the beef all over with 2 tsp salt and the pepper and set it on top. Whisk the tomato sauce, tomato paste, cumin, oregano, and garlic and pour it over the beef; add the remaining vegetables and the bay leaves.

steps.title: Slow-cook
steps.body: Cover and cook on LOW for 8 hours, until the beef pulls apart easily with a fork. Do not lift the lid during the first 6 hours.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: About 25 minutes before the beef is done, combine the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt in a 2-quart saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, cook on low 15 minutes, then rest covered 10 minutes. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Shred and finish
steps.body: Remove the bay leaves. Lift the beef onto a board, shred it with two forks, and discard any large pieces of fat. Return it to the cooker with the olives and vinegar, stir, and cook uncovered on HIGH 10 minutes so the sauce clings.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice. Spoon the ropa vieja and its sauce over the rice and scatter cilantro.

scaling_notes.4: As written; there are usually leftovers.
